chunks: Yet they say: 'When we are turned to bones and bits, shall we be raised as a new creation?'
ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers question about resurrection in Surah Al-Isra?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Isra is often cited to refute the materialist notion that resurrection requires the reassembly of identical physical particles, emphasizing instead God's absolute power to recreate existence from any state. The rhetorical question underscores the contrast between human limitation in perceiving decay and divine omnipotence in initiating a new creation, a theme central to debates on bodily vs. spiritual resurrection.
